He read the slip into the speaker to the harbor station on the mainland.", "w02": "凌晨四点，解放路路灯亮着。工农桥头，环卫工推铁车扫地。菜市街停了三辆货车，司机卸白菜，整捆往下倒。早点铺拉开铁门，小工在道牙子边拾掇葱姜。洒水车开过人民广场，水流冲刷柏油路。电车总站亮起排灯，头班司机打卡签到。天边发白，大楼现出方整轮廓来。", "w03": "• It is a task where you do one step, then pass the smaller rest of the task to yourself to repeat.\n• You must set a clear stopping point, or you will keep repeating the task and never finish.\n• Once you hit that stop, you wrap up each step in reverse order until the whole job is done."}
